scientific_integrity: The structural kernel-and-stabilizer description and the source family are taken from Smith; the exceptional parameter locus is independently derived by exhaustive exact cross-ratio comparison.
The checker enumerates all 120 permutations symbolically, so the completeness assertion is not inferred from numerical sampling.
scientific_limitations: The classification is over \(\mathbb C\) and concerns the displayed one-parameter family only.
It does not reclassify all quartic del Pezzo automorphism groups; it determines the exact pullback of the known symmetry strata to Smith’s parameter \(a\).
No arithmetic descent statement over smaller fields is claimed.
title: Complete symmetry-jump locus in Smith’s quartic del Pezzo family
